static.关系修改尚未保存，离开后可以回来继续。: Relationship changes are not saved yet. You can leave and return to continue.
static.当前关系与已保存设置一致。: The current relationship matches the saved settings.
static.这个来源的内容关系已保存。: The content relationship for this source has been saved.
static.这是连接后的同步方式。暂停时不接收新变化，已保存内容仍保留。: This is the sync policy after connecting. While paused, no new changes are received and saved content is retained.
static.本机继续保留，向中央发送已暂停: Content stays on the device; sending to Central is paused
static.各设备继续按本机设置保留内容，待发送内容会在恢复后继续同步。: Each device keeps content according to its local settings. Pending content will sync after sending resumes.
static.允许发送的本机内容会按各来源的设置同步到中央。: Local content allowed for sending syncs to Central according to each source’s settings.
static.屏幕采集、单个来源接收、向中央发送分别控制，状态独立保留。: Screen capture, intake from each source, and sending to Central have separate controls and retain independent states.
static.向中央发送已暂停，本机内容继续保留。: Sending to Central is paused. Local content is retained.
static.向中央发送已恢复。屏幕采集和各来源接收保持原有状态。: Sending to Central has resumed. Screen capture and source intake retain their previous states.
